name: helios-admin
description: Helios ops leads with full tailnet admin (autogroup:admin equivalent in this POC).

name: platform-eng
description: Owns and operates the internal services (admin-portal, identity-bridge, api-gateway, customer-portal, observability).

name: data-eng
description: Owns the data warehouse, ML platform, and ETL jobs. Read-only access to analytics.

name: sre
description: Operates the platform. Read metrics + logs on EKS gateway. No exec.

name: sre-lead
description: SRE leads with exec capability on EKS gateway. Also have full SRE access.

name: customer-success
description: Supports customers. Access to customer-portal (read) and identity-bridge (read). No DB, no admin tools.

name: sales-eng
description: Runs demos. Access to customer-portal, api-gateway, ml-platform (predict only).

name: auditors
description: SOC 2 / compliance auditors. Read-only access to observability. No DB, no SSH, no exec.

name: untrusted
description: Bucket for accounts that should not have access to anything (e.g. external test accounts, simulated attackers). Never referenced in any ACL src — exists only to make 'deny by absence' explicit.
